text.en: Believing the sky is blue because it reflects the ocean, and a sunset sky is red because it reflects the Sun's glow — attributing atmospheric colour to reflection rather than wavelength-dependent scattering.
text.et: Uskumine, et taevas on sinine, kuna see peegeldab ookeani, ja loojanguaegne taevas on punane, kuna see peegeldab Päikese kuma — atmosfääri värvi seostamine peegeldusega, mitte lainepikkusest sõltuva hajumisega.
